name: Carlyle Group Inc.
moat_justification: Diversified top-tier alternative manager ($485.5B AUM, $334.4B fee-earning AUM at June 30, 2026; Global Credit $211.1B, Global Private Equity $162.7B, AlpInvest $111.7B) with a growing recurring fee engine — record segment fee-related earnings of $358M in Q2 2026 (+11% YoY at a 47% FRE margin) and $1.2B in FY2025 (+12% YoY) — and sticky long-dated capital ($56B of LTM inflows). Capped at moderate because the product is competitively allocated risk capital with no structural pricing power (LPs re-bid every vintage among Blackstone/KKR/Apollo/Brookfield/Blue Owl), earnings are geared to the fundraising and exit cycle, and the filed evidence the rubric asks for does not exist: roic_proxy is null in every year of fundamentals.json (the filer captions no operating income) and gross_margin is null from FY2018 onward (no COGS caption), so no ROIC-above-cost-of-capital history can be quoted. A 5 gives CAP 8.5 years.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low
one_liner: Diversified alt manager with a record fee engine, moat 5/10 — Tier F on this screen: standardized owner's earnings are negative in 4 of the last 5 years (normalized base -$3.55/share, FY2025 -$10.11/share, TTM -$12.33/share) because consolidated GAAP OCF capitalizes consolidated-fund flows, not the manager's distributable earnings (segment FRE was a record $1.2B in FY2025); it does not clear 15% at any price on current OE numbers and no hurdle-clearing price is computed on a negative base.
moat_for: Scale and diversification — $485.5B total AUM and $334.4B fee-earning AUM at June 30, 2026 across Global Private Equity ($162.7B), Global Credit ($211.1B) and Carlyle AlpInvest ($111.7B), so no single strategy or vintage carries the firm

Recurring fee engine is growing — record fee-related earnings of $358M in Q2 2026 (+11% YoY, 47% FRE margin) and record FRE of $1.2B in FY2025 (+12% YoY) on the company's segment basis, with distributable earnings of $472M ($1.07/share) in Q2 2026

Sticky long-dated capital and fundraising momentum — $56B of inflows over the twelve months to Q2 2026 ($16.8B in the quarter), $28B of pending fee-earning AUM, and a rapidly growing wealth channel (Evergreen wealth assets +60% YoY to $20B)
Sustained capital return on the manager's own cash earnings — $0.35/share quarterly dividend ($1.40 TTM DPS in fundamentals.json), dividends paid TTM $504,500,000 and buybacks TTM $915,300,000
moat_against: No structural pricing power — LPs re-bid every vintage competitively among Blackstone, KKR, Apollo, Brookfield, Blue Owl and Ares; Carlyle wins allocations, it does not set the fee rate, and credit spreads have compressed as rivals scaled

No measurable ROIC or gross margin in the filings — operating income and COGS are not captioned (roic_proxy and gross_margin are null throughout fundamentals.json), so there is no filed return-on-capital series that stayed above the cost of capital through a cycle to underwrite a higher score

Earnings geared to the fundraising / exit cycle — performance revenues and marks swing GAAP revenue violently (FY2021 $8,782,100,000 to FY2023 $2,963,900,000 in financials_history.csv) and a closed exit market hits realizations, fundraising and marks at once

Consolidated balance-sheet opacity — GAAP OCF is dominated by consolidated fund / insurance-entity flows (FY2025 OCF -$3,275,500,000 vs net income +$808,700,000), consolidated-fund liabilities sit inside total liabilities of $22,058,900,000 with no engine-readable debt tag (the 10-K face shows corporate Debt obligations of $2,997,000,000 and Loans payable of Consolidated Funds of $10,426,000,000, neither captured by the engine's debt tags), and SBC is heavy and recurring ($374,700,000 in FY2025, $414,100,000 TTM)
